reasons.NR-NOGRAPH: No road graph, places or missions exist for this fire in the repo or in the fetched inputs (it is a forecast-scoring, calibration or training fire); the routing metrics are undefined.
reasons.NR-MARGIN: LAYOUT §7: the frozen margin rule exists for 5 h / 8 h horizons on known-perimeter inputs; the forecast arm exists at a 1-hour horizon on other issue times (V1, V2) or as retrospective scenarios (V3); V4 has no forecast arm. A run needs a rule mapping R to a 1-hour hazard that would be chosen after the full-system outputs are known.
reasons.NR-NOSWEEP: No recorded per-departure sweep exists for the V1 missions (committed per-departure checks cover the six 2025 planner caches only), so there is nothing to substitute for the field.
reasons.NR-LB: The router answers one departure per request; it produces no leave-by.
reasons.NR-V3JOBS: The V3 summaries are per place and place-run; job-level decided / route counts are not committed.
reasons.NR-V3HEATOFF: Heat closure off with the dose budget kept has no committed contrast, and the V3 inputs are not in the repo tree (rebuilt from three other branches by scripts/fdyn_rebuild_inputs.sh; the batch takes about 1 h 40 min with 3 workers per dwell mode) — not attempted.
reasons.NR-V3PERSIST: V3 hazards are retrospective reconstructions (kriged, FIRMS, envelope), not forecasts; there is no forecast to replace.
reasons.NR-V5: The v8 campaign has one arm and no ablation arms; only its own receipts exist.
reasons.NR-REFV2: No reference-router sweep is committed for V2; the planner caches were produced by the proposed router only.
reasons.NR-CALDOR: Caldor 2021 appears only in the v8 receipts; its graph is not in the fetched inputs, so no field or router can be run.
reasons.NR-V4: kcf-replay has margin arms only (R-based); it contains no forecast arm and no full-system arm to compare with.
reasons.NR-V3RUN: Not tabulated at this unit in a committed file.
